query: I am using our reddit-based custom forum website. After I reply to a nested comment, a blue banner appears above my reply. The banner contains a natural-language message with a link. What does that link say? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. In `Personalize List Columns`, look at the default `Selected` pane for the Assets list, Users list, and Catalog Items list. What is the bottom-most selected label on each page? Give the three labels in this order: Assets, Users, Catalog Items. Put the three short phrases in \boxed{} separated by semicolons.

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. I am on the product listings page. After selecting a few products and clicking "Update Attributes" in the Actions dropdown, I am brought to a new page. When I update an attribute and click Save, a banner with a green checkmark appears in the middle of the page, and another banner appears at the very top of the page. For the latter banner, what is the name of the link embedded in it? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. I am previewing themes. In the theme detail page that opens after clicking "View" for a theme entry, how many tabs are there in the left column? Your final answer should be in English (e.g., one, two, three) and wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. I am on the product listings page. After selecting a few products and clicking "Update Attributes" in the Actions dropdown, I am brought to a new page. If I click the "View Details" link, what is the field name on the resulting page that can be used to tell whether the update has been successful? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working in our ServiceNow portal on assigning incidents to agents with specific expertise. After clicking into an incident item in the incident list and clicking on the Assigned to search box, a small box sometimes pops up beneath it before any input is entered. What is the title of that box?

In the field-picker search dropdown used for list filters, typing `Type` on the Change Requests page and on the Catalog Items page reveals four extra matches besides the plain `Type` entry across the two pages. Give all four extra matches; order does not matter. Put the four short phrases in \boxed{} separated by semicolons.

B. Item name + Price + Quantity added
C. Item name + Quantity added + Cart subtotal
D. Item name + Link to shopping cart

If I then narrow the display scope by selecting a specific category name in the left column, two new links will appear after the category. What are the names of the links? Your final answer should be a comma-separated list of two phrases wrapped in \boxed{}.

B. The cell becomes highlighted.
